name: Fire and earth

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Torlok provides a Totem of Spirits and asks the seeker to capture the souls of enraged fire and earth elementals near the Hand. Their fury is not made into a speech, and the quest does not claim that the totem heals them at once. It gives a first measure of the wound: beneath Shadowmoon’s crust, both heat and stone have become hostile, waiting for the Earthen Ring to hear what they carry.
